description: OceanAdapt is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Rutgers University; Cooperative Institute for the North Atlantic Region; NOAA Fisheries. Explore how the distribution of almost 650 marine species have changed over the past 40 years, including species of interest for commercial and recreational fishing. OceanAdapt provides visual tools and a database to examine whether species distributions are changing. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Economy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
